scenes.title: A promise born in Mongolia
scenes.vo: Бага Рашаант компанийн Амин чанар брэнд нь монгол эрдэмтдийн 20 гаруй жилийн туршилт судалгааны үр дүнгээс эхтэй.
scenes.first: Dawn across mountain grasslands. Yaks sit low in the composition. No headline on frame 0000; let the landscape breathe.
scenes.last: Scientist at right; the complete 20+ жил headline holds at left. The landscape has resolved into the research story.
scenes.motion: 0.00–0.80: image only, slow 100→103% push. 0.80–1.60: 20+ rises 48 px through a mask; opacity 0→100%. 1.40–2.10: жил reveals. 2.10–6.80: hold. 6.80–8.00: 12-frame dissolve to scientist; headline stays locked.
scenes.transition: Wind bridges the opening. Match the curve of the mountain ridge to the laboratory glass rim. No flash.
scenes.asset: Higgsfield landscape concept; real research footage preferred for identifiable company history.
scenes.layout: Headline left, scientist right. White type; restrained gold 20+. Never cover the face.
scenes.lens: 24 mm wide aerial; sunrise rim light; very slow forward drift. Landscape to 50 mm scientist close-up. Camera horizon stays level.
scenes.sound: Wind and distant pasture ambience under the first words; felt-piano note enters softly. Narration begins at original time zero.

scenes.title: The curiosity behind the product
scenes.vo: Энэ хугацаанд сарлагийн сүү шар сүү болон адууны цуснаас амин хүчил пептид ялган авах чиглэлээр судалгаа хийж
scenes.first: Milk vial in the scientist's hand; warm backlight, dark green left field.
scenes.last: Abstract pale particles and a fine gold thread fill the frame. Two words sit on separate, deliberate lines.
scenes.motion: 0.00–2.00: gentle dolly toward vial. 2.00–3.00: Амин хүчил. appears word-first with 4-frame stagger. 4.50–5.50: Пептид. enters below. 6.50–8.00: glass highlight match-dissolves into particles. 8.00–11.00: both lines hold.
scenes.transition: Vial highlight becomes a particle. Thread continues into the next scene as the timeline baseline.
scenes.asset: Concept laboratory and molecular metaphor. VO describes research materials; do not imply the current milk product contains horse blood.
scenes.layout: Large left text with open leading. Particle metaphor is illustrative, not a molecular model.
scenes.lens: 50 mm scientist portrait to 100 mm macro vial; shallow depth; window light from upper right. Match circular glass highlights to protein spheres.
scenes.sound: Very quiet glass/vial sound on the cut; warm sustained pad continues. No exaggerated laboratory beeps.

scenes.title: The first milestone
scenes.sub:
Амин чанар нэрээр
бүтээгдэхүүн үйлдвэрлэх эрх
scenes.vo: 2016 онд Оюуны өмчийн газраас амин чанар нэрээр бүтээгдэхүүн үйлдвэрлэх эрхээ авсан үндэсний үйлдвэрлэгч юм.
scenes.first: Abstract emerald research field; a gold thread reaches the first timeline point.
scenes.last: 2016 fills the left half. The exact milestone sits below, with a thin line extending to the right.
scenes.motion: 0.00–0.70: draw baseline left→right. 0.70–1.50: four digits reveal together from a vertical mask. 1.50–2.40: caption enters with 5-frame stagger. 2.40–7.00: hold the milestone; the connecting line reaches the next point.
scenes.transition: Continuous lateral timeline movement into scene 04. Keep camera and line traveling in the same direction.
scenes.asset: Remotion typography and vector timeline. Use actual archival document only if supplied; do not invent certificates.
scenes.layout: Numeral oversized, gold on green. Caption milk white; readable at exhibition distance.
scenes.lens: Graphic frame with 2016 at 224 px equivalent on a 1920 canvas; gold rule across lower third; subtle defocused particle background.
scenes.sound: A soft felt tick marks 2016. No slot-machine or cash-register effects.

scenes.title: Research becomes production
scenes.vo: Улмаар 2017 онд Японы олон улсын хамтын ажиллагааны байгууллага Жайкагийн төслийн санхүүжилтээр 3 тонн хүчин чадалтай уургийн үйлдвэрийг барьж ашиглалтад оруулснаар сарлагийн сүүний уургийн пептид бүтээгдэхүүнээ албан ёсоор зах зээлд нэвтрүүлж эхэлсэн.
scenes.first: Factory aisle, symmetrical stainless-steel lines. Timeline glides in from the previous scene.
scenes.last: 2017 holds upper left; a large 3 тонн fact anchors lower left while production continues on the right.
scenes.motion: 0.00–1.00: 2016 slides upward and 2017 rises into place. 1.00–4.00: slow factory tracking shot. 4.00–4.80: 3 тонн reveals bottom-up. 5.00–5.60: supporting label fades in. 6.00–10.80: production inserts. 10.80–12.00: return to the full milestone hold.
scenes.transition: Match cut from stainless highlight to the white milk surface in scene 05.
scenes.asset: Real Baga Rashaant factory footage requested for final; generated facility is an explicitly labeled concept. 3 tonnes has no per-day/per-year unit in source.
scenes.layout: Two information levels only: year and capacity. JICA mentioned in notes/VO; no invented partner logo.
scenes.lens: 24 mm symmetrical factory aisle; slow central dolly; soft top light; restrained contrast on stainless surfaces. Insert close-ups of real process controls.
scenes.sound: Low room tone and one restrained mechanical detail; a gentle music lift as production begins.

scenes.title: The value of yak milk
scenes.vo: Сарлагийн сүү нь уураг шимт бодисын агууламжаараа онцлог түүхий эд юм.
scenes.first: Herder and yak; intimate hands-and-pail detail, warm morning light.
scenes.last: Suspended milk droplet over an ivory ripple. Сарлагийн сүү rests above the ripple.
scenes.motion: 0.00–1.80: hands/pail detail. 1.80–2.40: 8-frame match cut to milk. 2.40–3.20: headline gently expands from 98→100%, opacity 0→100%. 3.20–6.00: slow droplet moment; subtitle fades in over 12 frames.
scenes.transition: The milk droplet becomes a pale protein sphere in scene 06. Fluid movement carries the edit.
scenes.asset: Higgsfield herder and macro milk scenes. Authentic yak anatomy and Mongolian landscape; no cow substitution.
scenes.layout: White text on the green upper third. Keep the milk splash clear of copy.
scenes.lens: 50 mm herder hands and pail; natural light. Cut to 100 mm milk macro with high-speed photography feel and a clean emerald background.
scenes.sound: Pasture ambience gives way to a single soft milk drop; avoid loud splash effects under speech.

scenes.title: Making the invisible understandable
scenes.vo: Амин чанар Сарлагийн сүүний уургийн пептид нь сүүний уургийг 75-аас 98% хүртэл задлан боловсруулсан
scenes.first: A connected chain of pale spheres crosses emerald space; a small warm light begins tracing its length.
scenes.last: The chain separates into smaller groups. 75–98% is large and clear, with the process label beneath.
scenes.motion: 0.00–2.00: chain drifts laterally. 2.00–3.20: thread segments separate 40–70 px. 3.20–4.00: 75–98% reveals as one range. 4.00–5.00: caption fades. 5.00–9.20: hold with subtle particle drift. 9.20–10.00: one group travels right.
scenes.transition: Follow one particle group into the next scene. No explosions or glowing-body effects.
scenes.asset: Remotion vector particles over macro concept. Percentage is from supplied narration; confirm wording and evidence before final release.
scenes.layout: Statistic left, particles right. Never reinterpret this number as absorption percentage or efficacy.
scenes.lens: 100 mm abstract macro; cream spheres, delicate gold filament, shallow depth. Slow separation of clusters from a long protein chain.
scenes.sound: Subtle airy movement accompanies the separating chain; keep science section calm.

scenes.title: A clear time-based message
scenes.vo: хүний биед 15-аас 20 минутын дотор шимэгдэх боломжтой бөгөөд
scenes.first: Milk ripple seen from a low angle, with a fine circular line beginning to form.
scenes.last: Powder macro at right. The 15–20 numeral and минут label sit beside an incomplete, elegant arc.
scenes.motion: 0.00–0.70: arc draws around the statistic area. 0.70–1.30: 15–20 reveals. 1.30–1.70: минут rises 20 px. 1.70–5.00: clean statistic hold; arc remains incomplete and prepares the circular motif for scene 8.
scenes.transition: Arc breaks into the dot field of scene 08. Keep voiceover continuous.
scenes.asset: Symbolic timing graphic only; no stopwatch asserting guaranteed absorption. Claim retained from VO pending substantiation.
scenes.layout: Large numeral plus unit; tiny explanatory line avoided in film. No anatomical claims added.
scenes.lens: 100 mm milk/powder macro; side-lit ivory textures. A thin vector arc frames the time range without presenting a clinical measurement.
scenes.sound: One soft pulse when the time range settles; no ticking clock.

scenes.title: Twenty building blocks
scenes.vo: орлогдох болон үл орлогдох 20 төрлийн амин хүчил эрдэс бодис агуулдгаараа онцлог.
scenes.first: One gold particle enters from the previous arc; others are still faint.
scenes.last: Twenty small dots form a neat orbit at right. A monumental 20 and the amino-acid label hold left.
scenes.motion: 0.00–1.30: 20 dots appear in 4 groups of 5, every 6 frames. 1.30–2.00: numeral reveals at full value. 2.00–2.60: label enters; extra line follows 6 frames later. 2.60–6.00: slow 3-degree orbit and readable full hold.
scenes.transition: Twenty dots regroup into six anchors for the product-portfolio scene. Symbolic transition only.
scenes.asset: Editable Remotion/Figma vector dots; not a chemically accurate molecular diagram.
scenes.layout: Emerald field, ivory number, gold accent. Keep all 20 dots countable.
scenes.lens: Abstract macro background with a precise editable 20-dot orbit; 40 px diameter dots at 1080p. Keep typography static while orbit drifts.
scenes.sound: A light sequence of four quiet tones mirrors the dot groups. Narration remains dominant.

scenes.title: A growing family of products
scenes.vo: Өнөөдөр амин чанар брэнд, хэрэглэгчдийнхээ хэрэгцээнд нийцүүлсэн 6 төрлийн бүтээгдэхүүнийг тогтмол үйлдвэрлэн зах зээлд нийлүүлж байна.
scenes.first: Empty ivory product plinth, gentle light falling from upper right.
scenes.last: Six numbered graphic positions fan out beside the supplied hero product reference. No invented packaging.
scenes.motion: 0.00–1.40: product still gently settles from 104→100% scale. 1.40–2.20: 6 enters. 2.20–4.20: portfolio markers 01–06 reveal in sequence. 4.20–8.00: hold the complete composition. Cut on the plinth-to-horizon alignment.
scenes.transition: Ivory plinth edge aligns with a mountain ridge. Dissolve into the herder chapter.
scenes.asset: Only one product is visually documented in the supplied images. Obtain six actual packshots before displaying a six-SKU lineup.
scenes.layout: Product right, numeral left. Current board uses schematic portfolio markers, clearly identified in notes.
scenes.lens: 70 mm product stage; ivory stone plinth; softbox upper right; camera at pack mid-height. Six abstract markers until genuine SKU images arrive.
scenes.sound: Short, soft tonal lift for product reveal; no six repetitive impact sounds.

scenes.title: Value that stays in Mongolia
scenes.copy:
Монгол түүхий эд.
Монгол үнэ цэнэ.
scenes.vo: Бага Рашаант компани нь үндэсний түүхий эдийн үнэ цэнийг нэмэгдүүлэх, малчдын хөдөлмөрийг дэмжих, дотоодын хүнсний үйлдвэрлэлийг хөгжүүлэх хэрэглэгчдэд чанартай, аюулгүй бүтээгдэхүүн хүргэхийг үйлдвэрлэлийн үндсэн зорилгоо болгон ажиллаж байна.
scenes.first: Herder beside yak, hands in focus; open landscape remains behind.
scenes.last: Wide Mongolian valley with two short headline lines and a fine gold horizon.
scenes.motion: 0.00–3.00: portrait hold. 3.00–4.00: Монгол түүхий эд. wipes up. 5.20–6.20: Монгол үнэ цэнэ. reveals with matching rhythm. 6.20–9.80: valley expansion; subtitle appears. 9.80–12.00: title holds, atmosphere breathes.
scenes.transition: Gold horizon straightens into the quality-control rule of scene 11.
scenes.asset: Concept herder/landscape. Show authentic Mongolian livelihoods with dignity; secure real company/community footage when available.
scenes.layout: Two short phrases; no scrolling paragraph. Place type away from faces and herd.
scenes.lens: 35 mm environmental portrait; yak and herder in open steppe. End on 24 mm valley. Warm natural light, gentle handheld micro-movement only.
scenes.sound: Return to wind and tactile cloth/pail sounds; harmony opens warmly.

scenes.title: Quality made visible
scenes.vo: Энэ хүрээнд Ай Эс Өү 9001 2015 Ай Эс Өү 22 мянга 2018 асап аюулын дүн шинжилгээ, эгзэгтэй цэгийн хяналт, Жи Эм Пи үйлдвэрлэлийн зохистой дадал Жи Эйч Пи Эрүүл ахуйн зохистой дадал зэрэг олон улсын стандарт тогтолцоог амжилттай нэвт рүүлж
scenes.first: Symmetrical steel production aisle; calm neutral lighting and a darkened left text area.
scenes.last: Scientist inspects a vial. Quality headline above an orderly, readable standards strip.
scenes.motion: 0.00–1.20: headline masks upward in two lines, 6-frame stagger. 1.20–4.00: factory insert. 4.00–6.00: ISO names appear in narration order. 6.00–9.00: HACCP, GMP, GHP reveal at matched VO cues. 9.00–14.00: full strip holds over the scientist.
scenes.transition: Gentle green-to-ivory dissolve for the organic chapter; retain a small gold line.
scenes.asset: Real QA/factory footage and verified certificate artwork needed for final. Text-only standards; no fabricated seals.
scenes.layout: Use one restrained standards strip, not five bouncing badges. All labels at least 36 px at 1080p.
scenes.lens: 50 mm factory hands and laboratory details; neutral white balance; soft highlights. Use real process images when they arrive.
scenes.sound: Quiet factory room tone; subtle clicks only on standards transitions, ducked under voice.

scenes.title: A natural continuation
scenes.vo: мөн үндэсний органик бүтээгдэхүүний баталгаажуулалтыг хангаад байна.
scenes.first: Wide mountain grassland in soft morning light, with room for the visual transition.
scenes.last: Herder and yak with the organic headline settled over dark green negative space.
scenes.motion: 0.00–1.00: landscape breathes. 1.00–2.00: headline reveals along a horizontal mask. 2.00–2.60: label appears. 2.60–6.00: hold over the herder. Emerald match cut at the next scene boundary.
scenes.transition: Emerald color wipe leads to product-stage reveal in scene 13.
scenes.asset: Use actual national organic mark only once provided and confirmed. Current concept uses text, no invented certification icon.
scenes.layout: Short text, no false seal. Keep herder's face unobstructed.
scenes.lens: 50 mm meadow detail to 35 mm herder portrait; fresh daylight. Organic text floats over dark green negative space.
scenes.sound: Air and a gentle music breath; no certification stamp impact.

scenes.title: The hero at the 2026 event
scenes.vo: Энэ удаагийн ард түмний хүнс 2026 арга хэмжээнд бид 80,%,-ийн пептидийн агууламжтай амин чанар бүтээгдэхүүнээрээ оролцож байна.
scenes.first: Empty emerald studio stage, ivory plinth and milk glass. The product reveals immediately after the opening frame.
scenes.last: Hero pack at right, 80% at left, event name as a quiet upper label.
scenes.motion: 0.00–1.20: warm light sweep reveals product. 1.20–2.00: 80% rises 56 px behind mask. 2.00–2.70: descriptor fades in. 2.70–8.00: hero hold with a 2% camera push. The next cut follows the milk-glass motif.
scenes.transition: Glass of milk stays in the same screen position across the product-to-home cut.
scenes.asset: Supplied product reference to be replaced by clean approved packshot; verify 80% wording against packaging/specification.
scenes.layout: Most product-focused composition in the film. Emerald/ivory/gold. No event logo invented.
scenes.lens: 70–85 mm hero product lens; natural pack proportions; controlled key light and thin rim. Three-quarter view only if a real approved cutout supports it.
scenes.sound: Low soft rise into the pack reveal; one clean accent when 80% settles.

scenes.title: Nutrition belongs to everyday life
scenes.vo: Тус бүтээгдэхүүнийг уураг алдалттай үеийн хоол тэжээлийн дэмжлэг тамир тэнхээ болон дархлаа дэмжих ядаргаа хордлогын дараах нөхөн сэргэлтийн үед хэрэглэж ирсэн туршлагатай.
scenes.first: Adult daughter and older mother at breakfast. A quiet, believable shared moment.
scenes.last: Shared breakfast remains visible above a dark lower title band. The complete nutrition headline and support line hold below the faces.
scenes.motion: 0.00–3.00: natural performance, no headline. 3.00–4.20: headline reveals as two word groups on one baseline, with an 8-frame stagger. 4.20–5.00: supporting line fades in. 5.00–12.00: full lower-band hold; camera moves only 3%.
scenes.transition: Glass highlight match-cuts to a laboratory vial, connecting everyday life to evidence.
scenes.asset: Generated family scene is illustrative. No patient testimonial, before/after transformation, or guaranteed recovery imagery.
scenes.layout: Warm ivory type on a dark lower band. Keep faces and gestures above the title area.
scenes.lens: 50 mm home breakfast; quiet candid adult interaction; warm side window; low camera movement; real milk glass continuity.
scenes.sound: Natural breakfast room tone and a faint glass placement. Avoid audible actors speaking over the supplied narration.

scenes.title: Collaboration and observation
scenes.extra: УНТЭ • ХСҮТ • Хатанбаатар • Шинон Мед • Ачтан
scenes.vo: Мөн Улсын 1 дүгээр төв эмнэлэг, ХСҮТ Хатанбаатар, Шинон Мед, Ачтан зэрэг эмнэлгүүдтэй хамтран хийсэн клиник судалгаа ажиглалтуудаар тогтмол өндөр үр дүн үзүүлсээр байна.
scenes.first: Scientist inspecting a milk vial in an anonymous laboratory; calm documentary framing.
scenes.last: Full headline and text-only institution list on a clean dark field; scientist remains visible at right.
scenes.motion: 0.00–1.20: headline reveals. 2.00–6.00: two research details, slow cuts. 6.00–9.00: institution names fade in as one readable list, not endorsement badges. 9.00–13.20: hold. 13.20–14.00: gold thread moves toward horizon.
scenes.transition: Fine gold research line becomes the landscape horizon for the final brand promise.
scenes.asset: Final needs actual study citations and authorized institutional names/artwork. No efficacy chart or invented clinical result.
scenes.layout: Institutions as supporting text; avoid seal/checkmark composition implying hospital endorsement.
scenes.lens: 50 mm researcher portrait; 85 mm hands reviewing notes. No fictional hospital signage, actors posing as named researchers, or invented charts.
scenes.sound: Calm room tone, page-turn texture, restrained music. No sound suggesting an experimental success result.

scenes.title: Nature, science, and modern craft
scenes.vo: Бид Монгол орны үнэт түүхий эдийг шинжлэх ухаан судалгаа үйлдвэрлэлийг орчин үеийн технологитой хослуулан чанартай бүтээгдэхүүнийг хэрэглэгчдэдээ хүргэхийг зорин ажилласаар байна.
scenes.first: Return to the opening valley, now warmer and brighter. Visual recognition closes the story.
scenes.last: Emerald product stage. Three lines settle into a confident brand statement beside the product.
scenes.motion: 0.00–3.00: Байгаль. over landscape. 3.00–6.00: Шинжлэх ухаан. over laboratory. 6.00–9.00: Амин чанар. over product. Each word group masks in over 18 frames. 9.00–12.00: complete three-line statement holds.
scenes.transition: Cut to the milk macro for scene 17 on the end of the final word. Music begins its resolution.
scenes.asset: Reuse landscape/lab/product concepts; final pack geometry and label must remain faithful to supplied product.
scenes.layout: Three strong lines with deliberate rhythm. First two in ivory; final brand line in warm gold.
scenes.lens: 24 mm landscape → 50 mm laboratory → 85 mm product. Repeat the film's established compositions to create a satisfying resolution.
scenes.sound: Music reprise from the opening; one soft accent per major word group.

scenes.title: The line we remember
scenes.first: Milk droplet and still ivory liquid; no copy for the first few frames.
scenes.last: The slogan is fully visible above the expanding ripple, with generous space.
scenes.motion: 0.00–0.60: droplet lands. 0.60–1.40: first line rises 32 px; second follows after 5 frames. 1.40–4.00: slogan holds. Ripple expands slowly and becomes a circular spotlight.
scenes.transition: Ripple-to-spotlight match dissolve into final product end card.
scenes.asset: Milk macro concept; exact supplied slogan retained without rewriting.
scenes.layout: Centered slogan in the upper green field, above the milk ripple. 106 px equivalent type; generous line spacing.
scenes.lens: 100 mm milk macro; droplet and expanding ring. Camera locked; text supplies the emotional cadence.
scenes.sound: Single milk drop, sustained warm chord; allow the slogan to breathe.

scenes.title: A calm, unmistakable end card
scenes.vo: Бага Рашаант компанийн амин чанар брэнд.
scenes.first: Empty product stage arrives from the milk ripple; the pack and brand begin resolving immediately after this frame.
scenes.last: Final hero pack and brand lockup, fully visible. Hold through the last frame; no fade that cuts off the voiceover.
scenes.motion: 0.00–0.65: product and brand title opacity 0→100%, 98→100% scale. 0.65–1.10: company line fades. 1.10–3.833: static end-card hold. Music tail resolves within the available duration; voice stays untouched.
scenes.transition: End on brand. No invented URL, phone number, QR code, or extra CTA.
scenes.asset: Use approved logo and clean product cutout when provided. Board uses a typeset brand lockup and supplied product photo reference.
scenes.layout: Brand left, product right. Protect a final hold of at least 2.5 seconds.
scenes.lens: 85 mm product stage; camera locked at label height. Soft upper-right key and subtle ivory reflection. Final frame holds without black fade.
scenes.sound: Resolve the chord under the brand name. Keep full VO intact and finish music within the available tail.
